_comment: Per-channel source overrides, applied after the weekly refresh so they survive it. Key = tvg-id (exact). Swap a channel's stream URL (e.g. an HEVC/HDR-only feed that many phone browsers can't decode) for an H.264 one. Optional: name, group, lang, px (1 = route via proxy), hevc (0 = force-mark playable).

SunSurya.in@HD.note: H.264 Malayalam Surya (HEVC/HDR cloudfront feed can't decode on some phone browsers)
